user.title: Vinyl ID
user.description: Adds a Record Player that shows the song, cover and progress of the record the Vinyl ID app hears.

data.url: Address of the Vinyl ID app
data.speaker: Speaker that plays your record (optional)
data.listener: The app's silent speaker in Music Assistant (optional)

data_description.url: Leave as it is when the app runs on this Home Assistant.
data_description.speaker: The Record Player's volume and power buttons control this speaker. Leave empty to only show what is playing.
data_description.listener: Vinyl ID listens through a silent speaker, usually named Vinyl ID Listener. It is not the player to look at, so it is hidden from dashboards here. It keeps working and stays under Settings > Entities.

error.cannot_connect: No Vinyl ID app answered at that address. Check that the app is running.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Vinyl ID is already set up.
